subject: site context
outcome: The temple is positioned at a reproducible local model origin. Low-detail non-semantic stone scattering and ground plane provide a restrained site context.
acceptanceCriteriaReviewed: Represent supported local terrain and temple position in known coordinates
Separate simplified contextual dressing from source-backed reconstruction
validation: Architecture unit checks and rendered Chromium desktop/mobile review; relevant scene behavior inspected in source and QA captures.
limits: The terrain is illustrative and not a surveyed Acropolis DEM or GIS model.

review.note: Deliverable is implemented in independently authored project code and checked against recorded public evidence and browser tests.
